touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Alford qualifies as a local detour through Alford Manor House and Alford Windmill. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Alford: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Alford offers Alford Manor House, Alford Windmill, CHURCH OF ST WILFRID within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
